title: The Long, Twisted and Slightly Ridiculous Story of Avgas Part 2
summary: AVweb's Paul Bertorelli explains in part two of a series why general aviation has not replaced leaded avgas. He covers industry inertia, bureaucratic delays and the exemption that lets the industry keep using lead.
why: HN recommends the series for explaining why unleaded avgas has been so hard to approve, usually in threads about FAA and EPA fuel decisions.

quote.text: AVWeb made 2 videos on the subject of leaded avgas and on how hard it is to get it approved.
